title: Lane lint judges a lane's added lines with the check scripts the batch will run, not only the head's own copies
why: Lane lint runs the check scripts from the lane's head, so a lane that branched before a newer check passes lane lint and is then flagged at the batch, after the drop.
note: Lane lane-lint-runs-comment-check (session_013NEJKz3Pbvh8FJVoT2ydk8) read-only audit, 04:20 CST Nov 9. Incident: #1998 passed lane lint, but runner 8's batch-head narration check flagged hooks/test_guard.py "Rows marked (pin) pass on main today." (607cc31f8, line 2806), because the batch held draft #1879's newer pattern (narration-red-on-head-3, 0c4e2b294) and #1998's head did not. Unknowns: runner 8's batch head is not on origin; which head lane lint passed is unknown. Two routes, coordinator's pick (process): (1) lane lint also runs the check scripts from origin/main and from open check lanes on the lane's added lines; (2) the batch runner runs lane lint on the batch tree before the drop decision.
